Anna (Docs): Hey team — PR #4823 (migration + SDK snippet) is ready for final review. Need to lock merge timing: feature flag cutoff is Thu 18:00 UTC, and we need the docs in stable before the rollout. Can reviewers pls prioritize?

Leo (Engineer): re-run triggered: `./ci_runner rerun docs-preview --job ci/docsite` — kicked off. Also updated SDK snippet to use the new method name per runtime changes. Here's the snippet I changed:```python
# migration example
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(model='code-1', version='v1.8')
# note: use `generate` instead of deprecated `call`
resp = client.generate(prompt="Translate to SQL")
print(resp.text)
```Please check the import + method naming; this affects the quickstart and migration guide.
Sara (Docs): Thanks — LGTM on content, left one tiny nit about phrasing in the intro paragraph (suggested change inline). Approving once that small wording change is pushed.
Michael (Platform): Also FYI: if this needs backporting to `stable-1.8` branch, we should create the PR now. Release automation only watches `main` + `stable-*` branches for doc artifact uploads.
Anna (Docs): Yes please open the backport PR to `stable-1.8` after we merge main. I'll hold merge until: (1) 2 approvals (Sara + one more), (2) ci/docsite green, (3) preview link shows docs/v1.8/migration resolves. Planning tentative merge at 15:30 UTC to meet the before-16:00 window. Ping me when green. :thumbsup:
